Bubbles are rising from the regulator area towards the surface. The diver's fins are visible on their feet. The water is murky blue-green, reducing visibility and contrast.

The diver's arms and hands are indistinct blobs. It is unclear if they are holding equipment or just resting. The connection between the arm and the hand/fingers is melted and undefined.
